The holiday season can be full of fun, but the additional demands of your time & energy can leave you frustrated, irritated and unable to release tension in your mind & body. 

We will focus on our liver meridian to open a healthy flow of energy throughout the body.

No experience necessary and a lavender eye pillow is included to help bring some calmness.

Cost: $55

And includes snacks & tea
